oidc.title: OpenID Connect
oidc.help: Sign in with a Google, Discord, Keycloak… account. Each identity signs in an existing Meshloom account. Register Meshloom at the provider first.

presetHelp.generic: Give the issuer of your provider: its address without /.well-known/openid-configuration.
presetHelp.google: Create an OAuth client of type "Web application" in the Google Cloud console and add the redirect address below.
presetHelp.discord: Create an application in the Discord developer portal and add the redirect address below. Link accounts by subject.
presetHelp.keycloak: The issuer is your realm's address (https://keycloak.example/realms/home). Create a confidential client with the redirect address below.

oidc.label: Button label
oidc.secretKept: Stored: leave empty to keep it
oidc.privateNetwork: The provider is on my local network
oidc.privateNetworkHelp: For a provider on your local network, such as Keycloak.
oidc.autoCreate: Create an account for an unknown identity
oidc.autoCreateHelp: On, anyone the provider signs in gets a Viewer account. Only for a provider whose users you trust.
oidc.redirectUris: Redirect addresses to register at the provider
oidc.redirectUrisHelp: Register each address people sign in from at the provider.
oidc.testOk: The provider answered: issuer {{issuer}}, {{keys}} signing key(s).

links.title: Linked identities
links.help: Each line links one provider identity to an existing account, by verified e-mail or by subject.
links.subject: Subject

errors.auth_oidc_disabled: Sign-in with OpenID Connect is off.
errors.auth_oidc_incomplete: Set the issuer and the client id first.
errors.auth_oidc_issuer_invalid: The issuer must be an https address (http only for a provider on your local network).
errors.auth_oidc_issuer_mismatch: The provider announces another issuer: type the issuer exactly as it announces it.
errors.auth_oidc_metadata_invalid: The provider's configuration cannot be used.
errors.auth_oidc_unavailable: The provider could not be reached.
errors.auth_oidc_http_public: Plain http is accepted only for a provider on your local network.
errors.auth_oidc_scopes_invalid: Invalid scopes: words separated by spaces.
errors.auth_oidc_secret_store_unavailable: The secrets key of this instance is not available: the client secret cannot be stored.
errors.auth_oidc_secret_unreadable: The client secret cannot be read on this instance: an administrator types it again.
errors.auth_oidc_state_invalid: This sign-in expired or was started in another browser: try again.
errors.auth_oidc_denied: The provider did not sign you in.
errors.auth_oidc_exchange_failed: The provider refused the sign-in: check the client id and secret.
errors.auth_oidc_token_invalid: The provider's answer did not check: sign-in refused.
errors.auth_oidc_no_account: No Meshloom account is linked to this identity. Ask an administrator.
errors.auth_oidc_link_invalid: Give either a subject or an e-mail address.
errors.auth_oidc_link_user_invalid: Only an enabled local account (not a kiosk) can be linked.
